# Reel & Rank

> Reel & Rank is a three-person motion, video and search studio in Houston. Motion graphics, video ads, selling campaigns and SEO, GEO and AEO strategy. Drop an idea and get an initial example in one day.

## Studio Overview
- **Name:** Reel & Rank
- **Location:** Houston, Texas (Coordinates: 29.7604, -95.3698)
- **Team Size:** A dedicated team of three
- **Founder:** Manny Singh (Founder & Creative Technologist)
- **Corporate Pedigree:** Salesforce, United Airlines, Morgan Stanley, Banco Santander
- **Contact Email:** hello@reelandrank.com
- **Canonical Website:** https://reelandrank.com
- **Full LLM Context:** https://reelandrank.com/llms-full.txt

## Production Services & Flat-Rate Pricing
- **Motion graphics, set of three:** $250 (set of 3) — Initial example in one day. Three moves. One strong impression.
- **15-second advertisement:** $500 (advertisement) — Initial example in one day. Short on time. Long on personality.
- **Advertisement up to one minute:** $1,000 (advertisement) — Initial example in one day. More room. More story.
- **Search visibility: SEO, GEO and AEO:** From $1,000 (strategy and dashboard) — Scope agreed on a call. Be ready for the way people search.
- **Selling campaign:** From $2,000 (campaign) — Scope agreed in a call. A bigger idea, joined up.

## Career Packages (Led by Manny Singh)
- **Interview video:** $500 (package) — Put your story on screen.
- **Résumé, video and portfolio:** $1,000 (package) — Bring your experience together.
- **Complete career package:** $1,500 (package) — Show up ready for what is next.

## Core Philosophy & Commitments
- **Initial Draft Speed:** Creative idea submitted today receives an initial example within one working day (24 hours).
- **Scope Agreement:** Deliverables, formats, aspect ratios, and timing are locked before production starts.
- **Iterative Refinement:** Advertisement offers ($500 and $1,000) are refined with feedback until client approval within the agreed direction.
- **Search Transparency:** Strategy for SEO, GEO, and AEO with custom tracked metrics dashboard (no speculative ranking promises).
- **Founder Brand Portfolio:** Featured work is RamanRasa, founder-owned AI-assisted creative, presented as design craft rather than third-party testimonials.
